citations.assessment: The daughter speaking to Pappa is identified as his wife by Rashi; the son’s marriage arrangement and ketubbah visit are explicit in 52b, continuing on 53a. Arrangement is not independent proof of completed marriage.

holds.reason: The source summarizes both as marriages. The located son episode describes an arrangement and ketubbah visit; completed marriage is not independently established here.
Rava appears in the parallel discussion at Ketubot 39b:3, but this does not by itself establish direct interaction or resolve the unspecified internal pointer.

notes.text: Retain the narrator’s marriage summary. Located Pappa’s wife and his son’s arrangement; distinguish an attested arrangement from independently confirmed completed marriage. The unspecified pointer and Rava chronology remain qualified.
